title: Your SPY Hedge is Profitable, Now What?
text: So, there's another common issue here, which is there are points that your hedge will be in profit. And in terms of the quarterly puts, 53 out of 78 showed a profit sometime before expiration. Only eight actually paid something at expiration. And there was a scenario during COVID Q1 2020 where you had a 30X return. But, here's the problem. Most of the time when your return shows the highest is when you need the hedge the most because as soon as you sell this, you are now unhedged. You're getting rid of the very thing you want to offset risk. It's a really difficult way to do business, and there's a very, very, very delicate balance that you have to attempt to achieve there.
